chapterInfo.content:
6
Wɔde apam adaka no ba Yerusalem
(1 Berɛsosɛm 13.1-14; 15.25—16.6, 43)
1 # 1 Be 13 Na Dawid sane hyiahyiaa Israel mmarima a wɔayi wɔn nyinaa bio, wɔn ano si mpem aduasa. 2#Yos 15.9; Eks 25.22 Na Dawid sɔreeɛ, na ɔne dɔm a wɔka ne ho nyinaa kɔ kɔfirii Baale-yuda, sɛ wɔrekɔfa Nyankopɔn apam adaka a wɔbɔ din a ɛyɛ asafo AWURADE a ɔte Kerubim ntam no din wɔ soɔ no afiri hɔ aba. 3#1 Sa 7.1 Na wɔde Nyankopɔn adaka no sii teaseɛnam foforɔ so firii Abinadab fie a ɛwɔ kokoɔ soɔ no mu, na Abinadab mma Usa ne Ahio de teaseɛnam foforɔ a Nyankopɔn adaka no si soɔ no kɔe. 4Na Ahio di adaka no anim. 5Na Dawid ne Israel fie nyinaa de wɔn ahoɔden nyinaa de nsankuo, bɛnta a wɔde pepeaa nnua ayɛ, mpintin, nnonno, nsambɔ ne nnawuro goroo AWURADE anim. 6Na wɔduruu Nakon ayuporebea no, Usa tenee ne nsa kɔkaa Nyankopɔn adaka no sɔɔ mu, ɛfiri sɛ anantwie no hinhimii. 7#Num 4.15; 1 Sa 6.19 Na AWURADE bo fuu Usa, na mfomsoɔ no nti Onyankopɔn bɔɔ no wɔ hɔ, na ɔwuu Nyankopɔn adaka no nkyɛn mu. 8Na Dawid bo fui sɛ AWURADE atwe Usa aso wɔ n’abufuo mu. Na ɔfrɛɛ hɔ din sɛ Peres-usa#6.8 PERES-USA: Asekyerɛ ne: Usa so bufa. de bɛsi nnɛ. 9Na Dawid suroo AWURADE da no, na ɔkaa sɛ: AWURADE adaka no bɛba me nkyɛn sɛn nie? 10Enti Dawid ampɛ sɛ ɔde AWURADE adaka no ba ne nkyɛn, Dawid kuro no mu, na Dawid de mane kɔɔ Gitini Obed-edom fie. 11Na AWURADE adaka no sii Gitini Obed-edom fie abosome mmiɛnsa, na AWURADE hyiraa Obed-edom ne ne fie nyinaa.
12 # 1 Be 15 Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: AWURADE ahyira Obed-edom fie ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa, Nyankopɔn adaka no nti. Na Dawid kɔ kɔfaa Nyankopɔn adaka no firii Obed-edom fie de baa Dawid kuro mu anigyeɛ mu. 13#1 Ah 8.5 Na wɔn a wɔso AWURADE adaka no tutuu anammɔn nsia no, ɔde nantwie ne aboa a wadɔ bɔɔ afɔdeɛ. 14Na Dawid de n’ahoɔden nyinaa sae wɔ AWURADE anim; nso na Dawid de nwera asɔfotadeɛ amia. 15Na Dawid ne Israel fie nyinaa de osebɔ ne totorobɛntohyɛn de AWURADE adaka no foro bae.
16Na ɛbaa sɛ AWURADE adaka no duruu Dawid kuro mu no, Saulo babaa Mikal hwɛɛ mpomma mu, na ɔhunuu Ɔhene Dawid sɛ ɔrehurihuri na ɔresa AWURADE anim, na ɔbuu no animtia n’akoma mu.
17 # 1 Be 16 Na wɔde AWURADE adaka no bae de bɛsii ne siberɛ, ntomadan a Dawid asi ama no no mu. Na Dawid bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ AWURADE anim. 18#1 Ah 8.55 Na Dawid wiee ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no bɔ no, ɔde asafo AWURADE din hyiraa ɔman no. 19Na ɔkyɛɛ adeɛ maa ɔman no nyinaa, Israel man mu no nyinaa, mmarima ne mmaa, ɔmaa wɔn mu biara paanoo mua baako ne nankum ne bobe aba taterɛ. Ɛnna ɔman no nyinaa sii mu kɔɔ wɔn fie.
20Ɛnna Dawid sane bɛhyiraa ne fiefoɔ. Na Saulo ba Mikal firii adi bɛhyiaa Dawid, na ɔkaa sɛ: Animuonyam bɛn na Israel hene anya nnɛ, sɛ wapa ne ho nnɛ wɔ n’asomfoɔ mfenaa anim, sɛ ahuhufoɔ no bi pa ne ho a n’ani mmu ne dwɛ! 21#2 Sa 5.2 Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Mikal sɛ: AWURADE a ɔfirii w’agya ne ne fie nyinaa akyi yii me na ɔhyɛɛ me sɛ menni ne man Israel so hene no anim na megoroeɛ. 22Na mɛyɛ awiɛmfoɔ masene yei bio, na mayɛ w’ani so famni. Na mfenaa a woaka no, wɔn na mɛnya animuonyam wɔ wɔn ani so. 23Na Saulo babaa Mikal annya ɔba de kɔsii ne wuda.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na Dawid sane hyiahyiaa Israel mmarima a wɔayi wɔn nyinaa bio, wɔn ano si mpem aduasa. Na Dawid sɔreeɛ, na ɔne dɔm a wɔka ne ho nyinaa kɔ kɔfirii Baale-yuda, sɛ wɔrekɔfa Nyankopɔn apam adaka a wɔbɔ din a ɛyɛ asafo AWURADE a ɔte Kerubim ntam no din wɔ soɔ no afiri hɔ aba. Na wɔde Nyankopɔn adaka no sii teaseɛnam foforɔ so firii Abinadab fie a ɛwɔ kokoɔ soɔ no mu, na Abinadab mma Usa ne Ahio de teaseɛnam foforɔ a Nyankopɔn adaka no si soɔ no kɔe. Na Ahio di adaka no anim. Na Dawid ne Israel fie nyinaa de wɔn ahoɔden nyinaa de nsankuo, bɛnta a wɔde pepeaa nnua ayɛ, mpintin, nnonno, nsambɔ ne nnawuro goroo AWURADE anim. Na wɔduruu Nakon ayuporebea no, Usa tenee ne nsa kɔkaa Nyankopɔn adaka no sɔɔ mu, ɛfiri sɛ anantwie no hinhimii. Na AWURADE bo fuu Usa, na mfomsoɔ no nti Onyankopɔn bɔɔ no wɔ hɔ, na ɔwuu Nyankopɔn adaka no nkyɛn mu. Na Dawid bo fui sɛ AWURADE atwe Usa aso wɔ n’abufuo mu. Na ɔfrɛɛ hɔ din sɛ Peres-usa de bɛsi nnɛ. Na Dawid suroo AWURADE da no, na ɔkaa sɛ: AWURADE adaka no bɛba me nkyɛn sɛn nie? Enti Dawid ampɛ sɛ ɔde AWURADE adaka no ba ne nkyɛn, Dawid kuro no mu, na Dawid de mane kɔɔ Gitini Obed-edom fie. Na AWURADE adaka no sii Gitini Obed-edom fie abosome mmiɛnsa, na AWURADE hyiraa Obed-edom ne ne fie nyinaa.
Na wɔka kyerɛɛ Dawid sɛ: AWURADE ahyira Obed-edom fie ne deɛ ɔwɔ nyinaa, Nyankopɔn adaka no nti. Na Dawid kɔ kɔfaa Nyankopɔn adaka no firii Obed-edom fie de baa Dawid kuro mu anigyeɛ mu. Na wɔn a wɔso AWURADE adaka no tutuu anammɔn nsia no, ɔde nantwie ne aboa a wadɔ bɔɔ afɔdeɛ. Na Dawid de n’ahoɔden nyinaa sae wɔ AWURADE anim; nso na Dawid de nwera asɔfotadeɛ amia. Na Dawid ne Israel fie nyinaa de osebɔ ne totorobɛntohyɛn de AWURADE adaka no foro bae.
Na ɛbaa sɛ AWURADE adaka no duruu Dawid kuro mu no, Saulo babaa Mikal hwɛɛ mpomma mu, na ɔhunuu Ɔhene Dawid sɛ ɔrehurihuri na ɔresa AWURADE anim, na ɔbuu no animtia n’akoma mu.
Na wɔde AWURADE adaka no bae de bɛsii ne siberɛ, ntomadan a Dawid asi ama no no mu. Na Dawid bɔɔ ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ AWURADE anim. Na Dawid wiee ɔhyeɛ afɔdeɛ ne asomdwoeɛ afɔdeɛ no bɔ no, ɔde asafo AWURADE din hyiraa ɔman no. Na ɔkyɛɛ adeɛ maa ɔman no nyinaa, Israel man mu no nyinaa, mmarima ne mmaa, ɔmaa wɔn mu biara paanoo mua baako ne nankum ne bobe aba taterɛ. Ɛnna ɔman no nyinaa sii mu kɔɔ wɔn fie.
Ɛnna Dawid sane bɛhyiraa ne fiefoɔ. Na Saulo ba Mikal firii adi bɛhyiaa Dawid, na ɔkaa sɛ: Animuonyam bɛn na Israel hene anya nnɛ, sɛ wapa ne ho nnɛ wɔ n’asomfoɔ mfenaa anim, sɛ ahuhufoɔ no bi pa ne ho a n’ani mmu ne dwɛ! Na Dawid ka kyerɛɛ Mikal sɛ: AWURADE a ɔfirii w’agya ne ne fie nyinaa akyi yii me na ɔhyɛɛ me sɛ menni ne man Israel so hene no anim na megoroeɛ. Na mɛyɛ awiɛmfoɔ masene yei bio, na mayɛ w’ani so famni. Na mfenaa a woaka no, wɔn na mɛnya animuonyam wɔ wɔn ani so. Na Saulo babaa Mikal annya ɔba de kɔsii ne wuda.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
